escena: SCENE (after the session, studio in Miami, late afternoon): a hard low sun beam comes through the window and lands across the empty chair. On the table, an ink-blue folder lies open where it was left — the blue of the house, present as a real object of the work — and a single LIME-green sticky note is stuck to the edge of a printed layout, the one warm-bright accent in the frame. A marker with its cap off, a half-drunk glass, one lamp still on. 35mm at f/2.8, focus on the empty chair. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the table in shadow against the lens
